text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Out-of-fold power as a percentage of the generator's own capacity, days 1 to 7. Weeks are picked from measured power alone, pooled over the three farms: the windiest has the highest mean output, the calmest the lowest, and the most variable the largest swing in daily mean output. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire. Weeks carry no calendar date.'
text.tspan: Out-of-fold power as a percentage of the generator's own capacity, days 1 to 7.
Weeks are picked from measured power alone, pooled over the three farms: the windiest has the highest mean output,
the calmest the lowest, and the most variable the largest swing in daily mean output.
Three wind farms in Lincolnshire. Weeks carry no calendar date.
